correctness.rationale: A fixed full update cannot move any car. North blocking leaves exactly seven column types; east blocking requires a nonempty successor at each eastbound row. Indexed frozen cyclic words biject with closed walks of a specified weighted seven-state matrix. Symbolic determinant verification proves the polynomial in RESULT.md exactly, hence all-size counts. The unweighted characteristic cubic has discriminant -139 and a single real dominant root in the rational bracket (5.278039,5.278040), with the other roots of modulus its inverse square root. Inclusion-exclusion gives the exact mixed/vacant count; analytic spectral tilting proves the limiting vacancy fraction. A separate full two-phase simulator enumerates every input at widths three through seven. Risk: neither enumerator verifies independent external mathematical judgment; this is a proof plus reproducibility package, not an independent audit.

value.rationale: This is an exact all-circumference, all-species-population fixed-point partition function for the canonical BML model on a minimal genuinely two-dimensional periodic geometry. It provides the complete stationary reference ensemble for density-resolved analysis and gives a sharp qualitative feature: typical frozen configurations do not fill all sites; their vacancy fraction converges to a positive explicit algebraic constant. This distinguishes counting frozen microstates from the known basin-dependent jam transition. The exact count and density interpretation are not an arbitrary slice of a finite table.
